correctness.rationale: Admissible covering radius-R centers form lens B(0,R−r)∩B(se1,R). For an arbitrary transverse point, extremal centers reflect into its meridian plane without changing lens membership, reducing all n-dimensional hull sections to planar tangent-circle arcs. Derived the stated two-piece cross-section radius: original r-circle for z≤−r cosα and shifted R-circle above it until sα, integrated via Cavalieri to obtain Vn(α). Convex hull inclusion yields strict volume monotonicity. At α→0, s0−sα=[(R−r)(2R−r)/(2R)]α²+O(α⁴); differentiating under the integral gives Vn(0)−Vn(α)=Tn α+o(α), Tn=(R−r)(n−1)κ_{n−1}R^(n−1)B(1/2,n/2)>0. Elimination produces both sharp terminal limits. Independently checked n=3, R=2,r=1 numerical quadrature and T3=π²(R−r)R²; finite checks corroborate but do not prove the theorem.
